mode.title: Mode
mode.description: models = price and capability per model, cheapest first. providers = every company hosting a model, with its own price, speed and uptime. compare = one row per model naming the cheapest, fastest and most reliable provider and the price spread between them.

models.title: Models (optional)
models.description: Filter by model id or name, for example claude, gpt-4o, llama. Partial matches work. Empty returns the whole catalogue.

vendors.title: Vendors (optional)
vendors.description: openai, anthropic, google, meta-llama, mistralai, qwen, deepseek and so on. Empty returns all vendors.

promptTokens.title: Request size: input tokens
promptTokens.description: Used to price a realistic request. Also decides which pricing tier applies, since long prompts are billed at higher rates.

completionTokens.title: Request size: output tokens
completionTokens.description: Output tokens for the same costed request.

minContextLength.title: Minimum context window
minContextLength.description: Only return models whose context window is at least this many tokens. 0 disables the filter.

maxInputPricePerMillion.title: Maximum input price
maxInputPricePerMillion.description: Only return models charging at most this much per million input tokens. 0 disables the filter.

includeFree.title: Include free models
includeFree.description: Models priced at zero for both input and output.

includeRetiring.title: Include models with a retirement date
includeRetiring.description: Some models publish the date they will be withdrawn. Every row carries that date when there is one.

expandModels.title: How many models to expand
expandModels.description: Providers and compare modes. Provider detail costs one request per model, so the cheapest matching models are expanded first up to this many.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
